title: KRA status upload (BOW front end, KRA STATUS)
purpose: Each active client's KRA status: S submitted (under process), R rejected, H on hold, A accepted (validated or registered at the KRA; such clients get no KRA pop-up in BOW). Clients whose KRA status Ledgerline has not loaded (or not available at the KRA) are left out and counted in the note; new or changed clients since the last file. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.
